name: Review request
when: About a month after launch, once they’ve seen results.
subject: A small favour, {{first_name}}
preheader: Two minutes, and it helps more than you’d think.

blocks.title: Would you leave us a review?
blocks.text: It’s been a month since {{client_site}} went live. A short Google review helps other owners find us.
Hi {{first_name}}, a line or two is plenty. If something isn’t right, reply to this email instead and we’ll fix it first.
